instruction: Start playback of the video stream from here: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/adv_dv_atmos/main.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple's advanced Dolby Vision + Atmos HLS test stream (adv_dv_atmos). Uses the existing is_vlc_playing metric with type='url' to verify VLC is streaming the specified URL. No custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the streaming URL. The metric handles HLS streams by checking multiple XML paths for URL information.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is being streamed
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status XML from HTTP interface
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly handles 'type: url' rule and checks VLC state == 'playing'
Metric parameter handling is correct: receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['url'] and rule['type']
URL matching logic is robust with multiple strategies: direct match, filename match for HLS streams, and domain+path matching
Handles HLS stream edge cases where VLC may show filename instead of full URL
Expected URL matches the instruction URL exactly
Complete instruction coverage: both playback state and stream URL are verified
